mission.objective: Take the files from the records room
mission.exitCondition: Leave by any entry with the files before the alarm reaches Lockdown
mission.briefing: Halvorsen Tower, Bunker Hill, a 1974 tower and the security to match: key locks, analog cameras that sweep, four guards on tight rounds. Floor 22 is mostly vacant, so suites 2202 to 2210 are dark and quiet tonight. Come in through the loading dock on the north face after deliveries stop, take the files from the records room, and leave the way you came or by the roof hatch. Nobody gets hurt and nothing leaves but paper. The security here is game fiction, drawn from the building's class and era.
